text_en: My point is this: heirs, as long as they are minors, are no better than slaves, though they are the owners of all the property;
text_cn: 再说：承继人几时还是孩童，虽然他是一切家业的主人，却与奴隶没有分别，

text_en: but they remain under guardians and trustees until the date set by the father.
text_cn: 仍属于监护人和代理人的权下，直到父亲预定的期限。

text_en: So with us; while we were minors, we were enslaved to the elemental spirits of the world.
text_cn: 同样，当我们以前还作孩童的时候，我们是隶属于今世的蒙学权下；

text_en: But when the fullness of time had come, God sent his Son, born of a woman, born under the law,
text_cn: 但时期一满，天主就派遣了自己的儿子来，生于女人，生于法律之下，

text_en: in order to redeem those who were under the law, so that we might receive adoption as children.
text_cn: 为把在法律之下的人赎出来，使我们获得义子的地位。

text_en: And because you are children, God has sent the Spirit of his Son into our hearts, crying, “Abba! Father! ”
text_cn: 为证实你们确实是天主的子女，天主派遣了自己儿子的圣神，到我们心内喊说：“阿爸，父啊！”

text_en: So you are no longer a slave but a child, and if a child then also an heir, through God.
text_cn: 所以你已不再是奴隶，而是儿子了；如果是儿子，赖天主的恩宠，也成了承继人。

text_en: Formerly, when you did not know God, you were enslaved to beings that by nature are not gods.
text_cn: 当你们还不认识天主的时候，服事了一些本来不是神的神；

text_en: Now, however, that you have come to know God, or rather to be known by God, how can you turn back again to the weak and beggarly elemental spirits? How can you want to be enslaved to them again?
text_cn: 但如今你们认识了天主，更好说为天主所认识；那么，你们怎么又再回到那无能无用的蒙学里去，情愿再作他们的奴隶呢？

text_en: You are observing special days, and months, and seasons, and years.
text_cn: 你们竟又谨守某日、某月、某时、某年！

text_en: I am afraid that my work for you may have been wasted.
text_cn: 我真为你们担心，怕我白白地为你们辛苦了。

text_en: Friends, I beg you, become as I am, for I also have become as you are. You have done me no wrong.
text_cn: 弟兄们！我恳求你们要像我一样，因为我曾一度也像你们一样。你们一点也没有亏负过我。

text_en: You know that it was because of a physical infirmity that I first announced the gospel to you;
text_cn: 你们知道：当我初次给你们宣讲福音时，正当我身患重病，

text_en: though my condition put you to the test, you did not scorn or despise me, but welcomed me as an angel of God, as Christ Jesus.
text_cn: 虽然我的病势为你们是个试探，你们却没有轻看我，也没有厌弃我，反接待我有如一位天主的天使，有如基督耶稣。

text_en: What has become of the goodwill you felt? For I testify that, had it been possible, you would have torn out your eyes and given them to me.
text_cn: 那么，你们当日所庆幸的在哪里呢？我敢为你们作证：如若可能，你们那时也会把你们的眼睛挖出来给我。

text_en: Have I now become your enemy by telling you the truth?
text_cn: 那么，只因我给你们说实话，就成了你们的仇人吗？

text_en: They make much of you, but for no good purpose; they want to exclude you, so that you may make much of them.
text_cn: 那些人对你们表示关心，并不怀好意；他们只是愿意使你们与我隔绝，好叫你们也关心他们。

text_en: It is good to be made much of for a good purpose at all times, and not only when I am present with you.
text_cn: 受人关心固然是好的，但应怀好意，且该常常如此，并不单是我在你们中间的时候。

text_en: My little children, for whom I am again in the pain of childbirth until Christ is formed in you,
text_cn: 我的孩子们！我愿为你们再受产痛，直到基督在你们内形成为止。

text_en: I wish I were present with you now and could change my tone, for I am perplexed about you.
text_cn: 恨不得我现今就在你们跟前改变我的声调，因为我对你们实在放心不下。

text_en: Tell me, you who desire to be subject to the law, will you not listen to the law?
text_cn: 你们愿意属于法律的，请告诉我：你们没有听见法律说什么吗？

text_en: For it is written that Abraham had two sons, one by a slave woman and the other by a free woman.
text_cn: 法律曾记载说：亚巴郎有两个儿子：一个生于婢女，一个生于自由的妇人。

text_en: One, the child of the slave, was born according to the flesh; the other, the child of the free woman, was born through the promise.
text_cn: 那生于婢女的，是按常例而生的；但那生于自由妇人的，却是因恩许而生的。

text_en: Now this is an allegory: these women are two covenants. One woman, in fact, is Hagar, from Mount Sinai, bearing children for slavery.
text_cn: 这都含有寓意：那两个妇人是代表两个盟约：一是出于西乃山，生子为奴，那即是哈加尔──

text_en: Now Hagar is Mount Sinai in Arabia and corresponds to the present Jerusalem, for she is in slavery with her children.
text_cn: 西乃山是在阿剌伯──这哈加尔相当于现在的耶路撒冷，因为耶路撒冷与她的子女同为奴隶。

text_en: But the other woman corresponds to the Jerusalem above; she is free, and she is our mother.
text_cn: 然而那属于天上的耶路撒冷却是自由的，她就是我们的母亲：

text_en: For it is written, “Rejoice, you childless one, you who bear no children, burst into song and shout, you who endure no birth pangs; for the children of the desolate woman are more numerous than the children of the one who is married. ”
text_cn: 诚如经上记载说：“不生育的石女，喜乐吧！未经产痛的女人，欢呼高唱吧！因为被弃者的子女比有夫者的子女还多。”

text_en: Now you, my friends, are children of the promise, like Isaac.
text_cn: 弟兄们！你们像依撒格一样，是恩许的子女。

text_en: But just as at that time the child who was born according to the flesh persecuted the child who was born according to the Spirit, so it is now also.
text_cn: 但是，先前那按常例而生的怎样迫害了那按神恩而生的，如今还是这样。

text_en: But what does the scripture say? “Drive out the slave and her child; for the child of the slave will not share the inheritance with the child of the free woman. ”
text_cn: 然而经上说了什么？“你将婢女和她的儿子赶走，因为婢女的儿子不能与自由妇人的儿子，一同承受家业。”

text_en: So then, friends, we are children, not of the slave but of the free woman.
text_cn: 所以，弟兄们，我们不是婢女的子女，而是自由妇人的子女。
